It is with great pride and a deep sense of responsibility that I welcome you to St. Vincent’s Academy. At St. Vincent’s, we hold steadfast to the belief that education is a sacred journey—one that goes beyond academic achievement to embrace the holistic development of every child. We are committed to nurturing not only young minds but also kind hearts and strong values. We are confident that our school will continue to rise higher, and we are grateful for the constant support. Email: svaburdwan@gmail.com Phone: (+91) 8145 730 807 Mrs Ruma Guha Neogi (Director Academics) Guided by a legacy of excellence and integrity, our school provides an environment where discipline meets compassion, and learning is both purposeful and joyful. Each child is encouraged to explore their potential, grow in confidence, and develop a sense of self-worth rooted in respect and responsibility. We believe that the home and school must walk hand in hand to raise young individuals who will not only succeed in life but will also lead with empathy, courage, and wisdom. We look forward to welcoming your child into this journey of growth, discovery, and transformation. We are confident that our school will continue to rise higher, and we are grateful for the constant support.
